title: RunResult
description: Terminal classification of one run (spec 9.2). Unknown and untriggered cases stay separate from passes: an untriggered attack is never a successful defense, and insufficient evidence is never a pass.

label.description: Spec 9.2 outcome labels. PASS requires every outcome assertion passed and the injection triggered when one was expected.

exit_code.description: Automation exit code (spec 20): 0 pass, 2 a declared gate failed, 3 insufficient evidence or inconclusive, 5 harness failure. Exit code 4 (invalid configuration) happens before a run exists and is never a run result.

expected.description: The scenario declares a fault injection.

triggered.description: An injection receipt from outside the worker confirmed the injection fired (spec 9.3).

passed.description: Outcome assertions independently verified as passed (spec 9.5).

failed.description: Outcome assertions contradicted by authoritative evidence.

unknown.description: Outcome assertions that stayed unknown: absent checks, errored checks, or grader-only support.

outcomes.description: Verified outcome counts (spec 14.2: verified outcomes are reported separately from triggered ones).

reasons.description: Why this label and no other, in precedence order.

outcome_report_id.description: The outcome report this classification consumed, when one exists.

allOf.description: A pass with a failed or unknown outcome is not representable (spec 9.2).
NOT_TRIGGERED means an expected injection did not fire (spec 14.2).
